intents.scenario: Verify that a Person can be created with optional Phone field provided
intents.assertionCode:
var person = new Person(id, firstName, lastName, email, identityNumber, birthDate, phone);
Assert.That(person.Phone, Is.EqualTo(phone));
intents.acceptanceCriteria: Successful person creation with all fields including optional Phone

intents.scenario: Verify that a Person can be created with null Phone (optional field)
intents.assertionCode:
var person = new Person(id, firstName, lastName, email, identityNumber, birthDate, phone);
Assert.That(person.Phone, Is.Null);
intents.acceptanceCriteria: Successful person creation with optional Phone as null

intents.acceptanceCriteria: Successful person creation

intents.acceptanceCriteria: Reject creation if the person already exists (duplicate email)

intents.scenario: Verify that creation fails when a person with the same identity number already exists
intents.acceptanceCriteria: Reject creation if the person already exists (duplicate identity number)

intents.acceptanceCriteria: Reject creation if the person already exists

intents.scenario: Verify that the service handles repository exceptions gracefully
intents.acceptanceCriteria: System should handle errors gracefully

intents.scenario: Verify that a person is successfully added to the database
intents.acceptanceCriteria: Successful person creation

intents.scenario: Verify that repository returns true when email already exists in database
intents.assertionCode:
var exists = await repository.ExistsByEmailAsync(email);
Assert.That(exists, Is.True);
intents.acceptanceCriteria: Reject creation if the person already exists

intents.scenario: Verify that repository returns false when email does not exist in database
intents.assertionCode:
var exists = await repository.ExistsByEmailAsync(email);
Assert.That(exists, Is.False);
intents.acceptanceCriteria: Successful person creation

intents.scenario: Verify that repository returns true when identity number already exists in database
intents.assertionCode:
var exists = await repository.ExistsByIdentityNumberAsync(identityNumber);
Assert.That(exists, Is.True);
intents.acceptanceCriteria: Reject creation if the person already exists

intents.scenario: Verify that repository returns false when identity number does not exist in database
intents.assertionCode:
var exists = await repository.ExistsByIdentityNumberAsync(identityNumber);
Assert.That(exists, Is.False);
intents.acceptanceCriteria: Successful person creation
